analysis:
Reviewed both primary analyses against the supplied source replay and canonical T-041 definition. changelog.d/ssd-maintenance-header-verdicts.md:3-9 and docs/reference/ssd-kv-cache.md:372 (head patch) describe caching readable-header verdicts using device/inode/size/mtime/ctime, rechecking each fanout's directory conditions and never remembering failed reads. The documented TTL, budget, ownership and encryption policies remain unchanged. No supplied evidence independently establishes a security regression, weakened account scoping, plaintext disclosure or change to attestation, authorization or billing.
The test analysis reports additions in provider-swift/Tests/ProviderCoreTests/KVCacheSSD/SSDPrefixCacheTests.swift:3140-3240 concerning corruption with restored size/mtime and replacement of malformed files. Those tests are not replayed here, so their assertions and coverage cannot be independently verified. Source replay is explicitly incomplete and contains no runtime implementation.
Material integration questions remain for T-041, TB-007 and A-001: inspect SSDWholeRootMaintainer.swift's readableHeaderIdentities and fanoutPassesReadChecks with SSDNoFollowIO.swift and CacheStorage.swift to confirm cached verdicts preserve descriptor-relative no-follow traversal, directory/ACL and pinned-volume validation, modification detection and safe deletion after concurrent replacement. Verify cache pruning and interaction with hit/write/removal and retirement/epoch handling. Maintenance ownership must remain separate from authenticated payload admission. Documentation and reported test intentions do not prove these contracts; missing implementation is a coverage limit, not an observed missing control. Further runtime review is required before resolving the security conclusion.
